basic_details.job_title: Shivaji University Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for LMS Administrator, Assistant Network Administrator Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shivaji University, Kolhapur (शिवाजी विद्यापीठ, कोल्हापूर) will hold a walk-in interview and practical on 8 December 2026 at 10:30 AM to fill the posts of LMS Administrator and Assistant Network Administrator in its Computer Centre, under a project for 3 years funded by the university. Candidates must bring an application addressed to the Registrar, Shivaji University, Kolhapur. Educational and experience certificates with attested copies must be submitted to the Director, Computer Centre, from the date of the advertisement (23 November 2026) up to 8 December 2026, before 10:30 AM.

qualification.details: Age limit (both posts): minimum 30 years and maximum up to 40 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for age or any age relaxation. | Qualification: M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc. in Computer Science/Computer Engineering, B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science/Computer Engineering, Information Technology, E & TC, M.C.A. or equivalent with good academic record. Preference: Candidates with experience in Moodle, Google Class room and LMS, and who have worked with a reputed University. Pay: Rs. 1500/- per day (approximately Rs. 35,000/- per month). | Qualification: BE/B.Tech/M.Sc. in Electronics or Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics & Telecommunication (E & TC), OR equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution. Experience: 7-10 years of experience in handling large IT infrastructure, preferably in University or Government setup. Certificate (Desirable): Professional certifications such as CCNA or Microsoft or AWS or equivalent. Pay: Rs. 2000/- per day (approximately Rs. 50,000/- per month). | Check the official notification for the exact discipline-wise eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Selection is through a walk-in interview and a practical test. On 8 December 2026
eligible candidates will face the walk-in interview
and a practical examination will be held as required.
important_instructions: The project will run for a maximum of 3 years. The university has reserved the right to close the project before the end of the term. Services will be terminated immediately if the work is unsatisfactory. Working on the project alone gives no person a right to claim any post or position in the university. Candidates attend the interview at their own expense.

rows.details: Official walk-in notice for LMS Administrator and Assistant Network Administrator

faq.question: Q1. When is the Shivaji University walk-in interview for 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and practical will be held on 8 December 2026 at 10:30 AM at the Computer Centre, Main Administrative Building, Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit certificates?
faq.answer: Educational and experience certificates with attested copies must be submitted to the Director, Computer Centre, from the date of the advertisement up to 8 December 2026, before 10.30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are advertised under Advertisement No. 1/2026?
faq.answer: The advertisement covers two posts: LMS Administrator and Assistant Network Administrator. Both are in the Computer Centre of Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the LMS Administrator post?
faq.answer: M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc. in Computer Science/Computer Engineering, B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science/Computer Engineering, Information Technology, E & TC, M.C.A. or equivalent with good academic record. Experience in Moodle, Google Class room and LMS, and work with a reputed University, gets preference.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is needed for the Assistant Network Administrator post?
faq.answer: The post requires 7-10 years of experience in handling large IT infrastructure, preferably in University or Government setup. Certifications such as CCNA, Microsoft or AWS or equivalent are desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 30 years and maximum up to 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The LMS Administrator gets Rs. 1500/- per day (approximately Rs. 35,000/- per month). The Assistant Network Administrator gets Rs. 2000/- per day (approximately Rs. 50,000/- per month).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview of eligible candidates on 8 December 2026, and a practical examination will be held as required.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job at Shivaji University?
faq.answer: No. The posts are under a project that runs for a maximum of 3 years, and the university may close it earlier. Working on the project gives no claim to any post in the university.

faq.question: Q10. What should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring an application addressed to the Registrar, Shivaji University, Kolhapur, together with your original documents and photocopies.
